message:
The other day, I decided it was time to check our go-bags. You know, the ones tucked away in the closet that always seem to end up as a catch-all for old shoes and forgotten hats. I gathered my grandkids and turned it into a little adventure. We pulled everything out, sorted through the snacks, and even made a game of finding the oldest items. 

As we laughed and chatted about what we might need in case of an emergency, I realized it wasn’t just about the supplies. It was the togetherness that made it special, like we were preparing for a cozy camping trip right in our living room. 

Sometimes, a little prep can turn into a lovely moment, don’t you think?
